title: GitHub repository search fallback for ailang docs search

scope.primary_deliverable: Authenticated GitHub code-search fallback selected at the CLI boundary, with shared git remote parsing, one-hour result caching, tests, and user documentation.
out_of_scope: changes to the local Search implementation

milestones.title: Extract GitHub owner/repo parsing into internal/gitutil
acceptance_criteria: Create internal/gitutil.GitHubOwnerRepo with the current HTTPS/SSH parsing behavior and error behavior preserved; do not add a second parser.
Delete the private cmd/ailang getGitHubOwnerRepo implementation and update its existing call site to use gitutil.GitHubOwnerRepo.
Unit tests cover HTTPS and SSH GitHub remotes, .git suffix trimming, malformed/non-GitHub remotes, and git-command errors.
The coordinator package and the new gitutil package compile and their relevant tests pass.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./... passing.

milestones.title: Add the backend seam and authenticated GitHub code-search backend
acceptance_criteria: SearchBackend has the design-specified Search signature, and LocalBackend delegates to Search without modifying search.go.
GitHub backend resolves GITHUB_TOKEN first and gh auth token second, never logs token contents, and returns loud errors when no token or an invalid token is available.

GitHub requests use HTTPS, the established Accept/Authorization/API-version headers, a ten-second request timeout, validated owner/repo input, and internal/gitutil.GitHubOwnerRepo for repository detection.
Code-search response conversion preserves the docsearch result/statistics contract and handles pagination plus explicit 401, 403/429 rate-limit, 404, and network errors with actionable messages.
httptest-based tests cover authenticated success, request shape, token absence/rejection, rate limiting/reset reporting, malformed responses, repository errors, and context cancellation.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./... passing.

milestones.title: Add one-hour per-query GitHub result caching
acceptance_criteria: Cache entries live under ~/.ailang/cache/docsearch/github/ and use a SHA-256 key over the query/repository/subdirectory/limit dimensions.
Cache reads honor the one-hour TTL; expired, corrupt, or unwritable entries fail safely without returning incorrect search data.
Cache files contain results and metadata only, never the GitHub token; writes are atomic enough to avoid publishing partial JSON.
Tests prove cache hit/miss, TTL expiry, key separation, corrupt-entry handling, and no credential persistence.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./... passing.

milestones.title: Select the fallback at the CLI boundary and document it
acceptance_criteria: Explicit --path always selects LocalBackend; otherwise local design_docs/ then docs/ remain preferred, with findDocsDir behavior unchanged.
When local docs are absent, the CLI selects GitHub only when enabled and a usable token exists; AILANG_NO_GITHUB_SEARCH and the matching --no-github flag suppress it with a loud actionable error.
Local execution makes no GitHub request, and outside-source-tree failures name the missing local docs/token conditions and provide --path/GITHUB_TOKEN/gh-auth guidance.
Existing docs-search regression behavior remains covered, and CLI tests cover local preference, disabled fallback, no-token, authenticated fallback, and error output without leaking secrets.
cli.md and CHANGELOG.md state plainly that GitHub code search requires authentication and describe the cache/disable configuration.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./... passing.

milestones.title: Run final integration gates and certify the hard unchanged file
acceptance_criteria: git diff -- internal/docsearch/search.go is empty (zero diff lines); no formatting, import, comment, or incidental change is permitted in that file.
Relevant package tests, go test ./..., go build ./..., make fmt-check, make lint, make check-boundaries, and make check-file-sizes pass from this worktree.
An outside-source-tree integration test with a test HTTP server or injected client proves authenticated fallback; no live token is committed or printed.
The final diff contains only the design-doc Files Changed table plus the explicitly required gitutil test companion, and no dead code remains.

final_gates: git diff --name-only matches the approved file list
